title: Screen Before You Interpret: A Portable Validity Screen for Benchmark-Based LLM Confidence Signals
abstract: arXiv:2604.17714v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM confidence signals drive abstention, routing and escalation, yet evaluations rarely check whether a signal varies with correctness before computing metrics on it. Clinical personality assessment handles the analogous problem by screening response validity before interpreting substantive scales. We specify a portable screen in that tradition. From the correctness-by-confidence table it computes the rate of high confidence on errors (L), the rate of low confidence on correct answers (Fp), and their contrast (RBS, equal to minus Youden's J). It adds no new statistics: it separates blanket confidence, blanket withdrawal and inversion, attaches interval guards, and calls a signal Valid only when it measurably tracks correctness. translated_title: 先筛查再解读：一种面向基于基准测试的LLM置信度信号的可移植有效性筛查方法
translated_abstract: LLM置信度信号驱动着弃答、路由和升级等决策，然而现有评估很少在计算指标之前检查信号是否随正确性而变化。临床人格评估领域通过在解读实质性量表之前筛查反应有效性来处理类似的问题。我们遵循这一传统，规范了一种可移植的筛查方法。该方法从正确性-置信度列联表中计算三个指标：错误上高置信度的比率（L）、正确答案上低置信度的比率（Fp）以及二者的对比度（RBS，等于负的Youden's J统计量）。它不引入任何新的统计量，而是区分整体高置信度、整体弃答和反转三种失效模式，附加区间保护措施，并且只有当信号可测量地跟踪正确性时才将其判定为有效。在20个前沿模型对452个二选一题目进行二元KEEP/WITHDRAW（保留/弃答）探测的实验中，一个模型被判定为无效（DeepSeek-R1弃答了其95%的正确答案），四个模型为不确定，15个模型为有效。
tldr: 本文借鉴临床人格评估的有效性筛查传统，提出一种基于L、Fp和RBS指标的可移植筛查方法，在解读之前检验LLM置信度信号是否真正跟踪正确性，对20个前沿模型的评估发现15个有效、4个不确定、1个无效（DeepSeek-R1弃答了95%的正确答案）。
en_tdlr: Inspired by clinical personality assessment validity screening, this paper proposes a portable screen using L, Fp, and RBS metrics to verify whether LLM confidence signals measurably track correctness before interpretation, finding 15 of 20 frontier models valid, 4 indeterminate, and 1 invalid (DeepSeek-R1 withdraws 95% of its correct answers).
